user_problem: Owners struggle to define what a recurring task should do, skip, escalate, and record.
unique_output: A recurrence contract specifying trigger, inputs, allowed actions, exclusions, completion evidence, escalation, and stop conditions.
test_case: Turn a vague weekly cleanup request into a bounded contract and identify an action requiring separate authorization.
overlap_to_check: Instruction authoring, support workflows, and content-refresh planning.
specific_guardrail: Write a proposed recurrence contract only; do not schedule automation, infer authorization or execute cleanup. Distinguish requested action, authorized action and unresolved scope.
